context.narrative_job: Make the difference between historical revenue and transferable operating capability visible.
context.viewer_before: The buyer asks about a month of owner absence; a successful business may look like a sufficient asset.
context.viewer_after: Revenue records can stay while the know-how needed to repeat the work leaves. A business can remain dependent on people without depending on this owner.

data.choice: Continue buyer film without another zoom. Use the presenter for the question, then hold the business/job heading alone before constructing a small workshop, owner and operating bench in steps.
data.reason: The audience first receives the question, then discovers the mechanism. Removing a tangible know-how component tests the difference between saleable operation and an owner-dependent job.

alternatives.choice: Keep the complete R37 funnel and animate its labels
alternatives.reason_not_selected: The owner rejected its early density and illustration quality; incremental labels alone would retain the same weak form.

alternatives.choice: Show only turning gears after the owner leaves
alternatives.reason_not_selected: That would imply transferability requires automation. A worker continues using a retained routine instead.
The question benefits from direct address; the operating test benefits from visibly separating prior evidence and ongoing capability.

reuse.applies_when: A concept must be discovered gradually and then tested by removing one dependency.
reuse.avoid_when: A complete diagram is already familiar or the relationship does not depend on persistent components.

animation.form: Progressive construction of one human-operated workbench
animation.mark_style: Authored Boundary Ledger ink illustrations with selective retraced edges and typeset labels
animation.entry: Heading only, then two small illustrative candidates
animation.change: Separate historical receipts from the routine and people that produce future work; remove the owner under two labeled conditions
animation.hold: Keep the absent know-how and waiting work visible without inventing the seller outcome

nuance.performance: V5 wide source, hands visible, near-viewer eye line, restrained pensive question and quiet settling through small talk. New matching take required.
nuance.false_inference: This is a conceptual comparison, not actual seller failure, measured lost revenue or a requirement to automate all labor.
nuance.source_basis: Current explicit owner revision plus director implementation judgment. Paid work remains a concrete proposed package.
